atlas_anomaly.title: Unexpected serverless or cloud-workload invocation — T1648 Serverless Execution
atlas_anomaly.expected_behavior: functions are invoked by known trigger and caller combinations with stable rates.
atlas_anomaly.deviation: new caller-trigger edge, burst, or invocation outside established temporal context.

context_references.title: Sysdig AI-assisted cloud intrusion investigation — downloaded copy

analytics.name: Analytic 1053
analytics.guidance: Correlate creation or modification of serverless functions (e.g., AWS Lambda, GCP Cloud Functions, Azure Functions) with anomalous IAM role assignments or permissions escalation events. Detect subsequent executions of newly created functions that perform unexpected actions such as spawning outbound network connections, accessing sensitive resources, or creating additional credentials.

tuning.description: Which IAM roles or privileges are considered sensitive when applied to functions
Known baseline list of approved serverless functions to reduce false positives
Temporal threshold for correlating function creation with anomalous execution

log_sources.name: AWS:CloudTrail
log_sources.channel: CreateFunction / UpdateFunctionConfiguration: Function creation, role assignment, or configuration change events

log_sources.name: AWS:CloudTrail
log_sources.channel: InvokeFunction: Unexpected or repeated invocation of functions not tied to known workflows

analytics.name: Analytic 1054
analytics.guidance: Monitor for creation of new Power Automate flows or equivalent automation scripts that trigger on user or file events. Detect anomalous actions performed by these automations, such as email forwarding, anonymous link creation, or unexpected API calls to external endpoints.

tuning.description: Business units or users where automation creation is expected (developers, admins)
Specific automation actions (email forwarding, file sharing) that should be considered suspicious

log_sources.name: m365:unified
log_sources.channel: AddFlow / UpdateFlow: New automation or workflow creation events

log_sources.name: m365:exchange
log_sources.channel: New-InboxRule: Automation that triggers abnormal forwarding or external link generation

analytics.name: Analytic 1055
analytics.guidance: Track creation or update of SaaS automation scripts (e.g., Google Workspace Apps Script). Detect when these scripts are bound to user events such as file opens or account modifications, and correlate with subsequent abnormal API calls that exfiltrate or modify user data.

tuning.description: Which SaaS apps or APIs can be legitimately automated in the environment
Event-driven triggers (e.g., on file open, on user creation) considered suspicious

log_sources.name: saas:appsscript
log_sources.channel: Create / Update: Deployment of scripts with event-driven triggers

log_sources.name: saas:googledrive
log_sources.channel: FileOpen / FileAccess: Event-driven script triggering on user file actions
